key_insight: Neural operator surrogates significantly accelerate Bayesian inverse design in CFD by reducing inference time while maintaining posterior accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The integration of neural operators aids in efficient aerodynamic geometry inference, crucial for practical engineering applications.
method: Embedded neural operator surrogates within MCMC inference loop.
Used cubic B-splines for stable uncertainty estimates.
Substituted a Deep Operator Network for the CFD solver in No-U-Turn Sampler.
evidence_signal: Surrogate-based inference matched the posterior geometry and uncertainty trends of traditional CFD reference across various observation regimes.
watch_item: The effect of surrogate models on posterior structure in shock-dominated flows remains an area for further investigation.
paper_title: Accelerating Bayesian inverse design in computational fluid dynamics using neural operators
